mr_description: We now have all the necessary APIs to allow to remove our usages of the deprecated `ComponentFactoryResolver`.

expected_issues.title: Component portals always use the root environment injector
expected_issues.description:
createComponent() now always receives the application root as environmentInjector, ignoring child environment injectors (lazy-loaded routes, createEnvironmentInjector) present above the portal's element injector, so providers from those scopes are not found.

With ComponentFactoryResolver the resolver carried the right module/environment scope. The replacement passes `this._appRef.injector` unconditionally; a component attached through a DomPortalOutlet (overlays, dialogs, snack bars) from a lazy route can no longer inject services provided in that route's environment injector (NullInjectorError or wrong singleton instance). The environment injector must be resolved from the element injector (elementInjector.get(EnvironmentInjector, appRef.injector)).
